question: Do the errors of the model reflect linguistic similarity between different L1s?
title: A Portuguese Native Language Identification Dataset
answer_rationale: The retrieved documents discuss the compilation, structure, and applications of the NLI-PT dataset, including its use in Native Language Identification (NLI) and linguistic analysis. However, none of the documents explicitly address whether the errors of the model reflect linguistic similarity between different L1s. While the documents mention that NLI models identify language use patterns influenced by L1, they do not link model errors directly to linguistic similarity between L1s.
